inheritance: Every instance keeps routes to its canonical owner(s) and provenance.
Structural roles may stack: e.g. Bible Comparison is both View and Table; House guide is both View and Court.
A new role classification never changes claim truth status by itself.
Containment and role are separate: a Room can host a Field, emit a View, participate in a Vineyard and expose a Door.
Promotion moves responsibility into the correct owner but preserves research/source history.
Roads and Doors are distinct: a Road connects laterally; a Door changes state/context under a guard.
Population-pulse diagnostics may guide maintenance but never determine truth, prestige or ownership.
A Bridge creates capability across separation; it does not erase the separation or merge endpoint ownership.
A Protocol coordinates heterogeneous nodes through shared grammar; it must preserve local identity and transparent revision/appeal where applicable.
A Foundation is distinct from Root and Seed: Roots may predate it; a Seed becomes Foundation only when a durable reference/platform and reproduction mechanism exist.
health_checks: Can a visitor tell whether the thing owns facts or merely presents/routes them?
Can every View/Path/Programme return to canonical owners and evidence?
Do Fields remain open rather than masquerading as settled structure?
Do Programmes/Vineyards state mission, inputs, outputs and review?
Do Doors state what changes and what remains invariant?
Are Archive and Treasury kept distinct?
Are States kept distinct from identities and containers?
Is any candidate being promoted solely because there is a lot of content about it?
Are important adjacencies represented as typed Roads or guarded Doors rather than generic proximity?
Does the population pulse reveal missing roots/interfaces without being mistaken for a quality score?
For anything labeled Foundation, can a later generation reinstantiate the system from its rules/practices/roles/standards without personal access to the founder?
